items.q: over the radio at Sherman I used to hear bands like Les Hite

ctx.x: There wasn't anybody here that at that time that was interested in jazz, but I think it's because they just didn't have the a, the background that I had and have

since -- as far as they ever were, they were at Armstrong. Now, there were -- over the radio at Sherman I used to hear bands like Les Hite and then there was a band called the Irving Brothers. And they were coming to the network from Culver City. Les Hite was there, Frank Sebastian's Cotton Club. And a . . .
What about the Earl Hines' Orchestra?
